historical_record.description: The 12-unit apartment building, six residential floors of two units each, was built in 1922.
The building held eleven two-bedroom apartments renting for $425 to $475 a month and one one-bedroom renting for $375.

The City Planning Commission unanimously found the conversion of the 12 rental apartments into condominiums consistent with the Master Plan, with tenants given the first right to buy (Resolution 7781).
